summary.headline: Driver reporting prerequisites use the current driver update management name
summary.summary: Driver report prerequisites now direct administrators to Manage Windows driver updates for the required environment conditions.
summary.adminImpact: Validate driver update prerequisites before relying on driver update reports.

summary.headline: Quality update distribution reports use consistent quality-update terminology
summary.summary: The distribution report is described as a sequence of organizational reports and consistently refers to quality updates when presenting device counts for the selected scope.
summary.adminImpact: Use the Windows Update Distribution Report to compare device counts by quality update.

summary.headline: Hotpatch monitoring guidance moves out of the quality update overview
summary.summary: The quality update overview no longer includes the Hotpatch monitoring and reporting section that described deployment status and errors.
summary.adminImpact: Use the current reporting guidance when monitoring Hotpatch deployment and errors.

summary.headline: Qlik Analytics is available with Intune app protection
summary.summary: Qlik Analytics provides Android and iOS access to cloud analytics, dashboards, offline downloaded analytics, metric alerts, and insight sharing while using Intune app protection policies.
summary.adminImpact: Evaluate the mobile app and assign appropriate app protection policies before enabling analytics access.

summary.headline: Jump AI is available with Intune app protection
summary.summary: Jump AI supports Android and iOS meeting recording, uploaded recordings, structured notes, meeting review, and recorded-content management under Intune app protection policies.
summary.adminImpact: Assess recording and note-handling requirements before deploying Jump AI with app protection.
